intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently test the assigned alpine treeline ecotone gradient as the dominant, observable structure in a complex photorealistic environmental portrait that uses the supplied image only as a general adult appearance reference.

Create a photorealistic wide environmental portrait at first light after an overnight sleet squall. Show a complete alpine treeline ecotone gradient running upslope from dense lower forest through sparse upright trees and wind-pruned krummholz to open alpine tundra. On a volcanic saddle above a cloud-filled valley, place an unmistakably adult mountain cartographer whose general facial appearance and long dark softly waved hair follow the supplied appearance reference, reading a folded contour map while standing on a volcanic saddle above a cloud-filled valley. Keep the cartographer at the lower-right third, medium-full and small enough that the vegetation transition remains the dominant subject, yet close enough for a clearly visible face and natural skin texture. Use a 32 mm panoramic documentary frame from contour level, deep focus, and broken backlight separating mist from each vegetation band. Sleet beads on a practical red shell while wet grass, stunted branches, scattered rocks, and lifting cloud add physical realism. The lower forest, sparse transition trees, contorted krummholz band, and treeless tundra must remain spatially distinct and unobstructed within one continuous slope.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
